items.originalTitle: Mistral Large 4 ( mistral-large-4 , mistral-large-4-0 ) now supports reasoning_effort values low , medium , and high , and no longer accepts none . Requests that set reasoning_effort="none" return HTTP 400. Mistral Large 4 always reasons: use low for the least reasoning. If you omit reasoning_effort , the model uses high . For details, see Mistral Large 4 reasoning effort .
